Subject: Sampling request: access lifecycle artifacts (onboarding + exits)

Hi Rafael,

As part of Brightline's SOC2 sampling for Redwood Inference, we need a small representative set of artifacts showing how you handle access provisioning and deprovisioning for employees (hire, role change, termination). Can you confirm whether you can provide redacted samples and a short chain-of-custody note (who requested the access, approver, owner) by Friday 11/17? If there are playbooks or runbooks for offboarding we can include those links instead of full docs.
